title: Intended containment is not a collision; every real overlap still is
requirement: Placeholder-in-field, text-in-row, label-on-button, content-in-card and status-inside-badge are containment. An intentional overlay is intentional. Unrelated text overlapping, clipped text and a connector crossing content are defects.
detail: 5 intended containments left alone; the stray connector and the overlapping text are reported
